refuted_claims: RF1 (L4 'inherited'): refuted. On links, a non-fragrance JSON-LD page whose title carries a category word is compared as a fragrance next to an EDT/EDP page. The same pair typed or photographed is refused. Cause: URL products carry the extraction LLM's category or 'other' (url_extraction_service.py:1216), never the classify_category_from_text name stub that the explicit and vision paths build (structured_comparison_service.py:4316 / :4299) and that post_resolve_refusal(parser_path=False) assumes (category_gate.py:654-656). Measured in probe_mixed.txt and proto1.log: Dior Sauvage EDT + Dell XPS 13 Laptop gives POST 200, generate(category='fragrances'), 0 A2b, 0 EVAL. Text and camera stubs give [other, electronics] and refuse. See B1.

RF2 (L5 'compared as fragrances', '(GC-2 on links)'): refuted. Measured on the prototype with Gucci GG Marmont Shoulder + Prada Re-Edition 2005 and the A2b answering 'fashion'. No chip: 200, A2b 0, generate(category='other'). Chip 'fragrances': category 'fragrances'. This is broader than GC-2, which S81-10 applies only WITH a real chip; with no chip S81-10 lets the resolver's A2b decide, and it refuses this pair (RULINGS_FIX1 GR-2 / F1-4 / F1-13).

blocking: B1 (rule before RED): the link decision has no per-product name stub, so a mixed link pair is delivered and billed as a fragrance compare where the text and camera paths refuse it. URL products carry the extraction LLM's category or 'other' (most JSON-LD pages never reach the LLM: spec 1.4). Rule 1 runs over the concatenated pair, so one fragrance form or concentration word unblocks it (category_gate.py:368-369, :394-396). post_resolve then sees [fragrances, other] and proceeds (:668-678), and GC-1 relabels the pair 'fragrances'. Measured end to end on a prototype of 3.1-3.3: Dior Sauvage EDT + Dell XPS 13 Laptop and Lattafa Khamrah EDP + Galaxy S24 Smartphone (both JSON-LD) -> 200, generate(category='fragrances'), 0 A2b, 0 EVAL. The same pairs typed or photographed are refused 'electronics' through the classify_category_from_text stubs (structured_comparison_service.py:4316 / :4299). TV and shampoo pages also pass on links (and on text/camera, whose stub map lacks the words); a per-product rule 1 refuses them. Options, all $0: (a) per-product rule 1 over each 'other' product's own '<brand> <name>' (recommended); (b) classify_category_from_text stub parity with vision; (c) restate L4 with the measured examples.

CR2: build 3 (683f56c0) renders both link refusals with 'Sharper match coming up ... try with brand or model', which asks the user to retype. Acceptable only because the flip waits for the S81-11 OTA (R-S10-14) and C11 is recorded. No Paywall on the 429 (measured).

CR3: GC-1 changes the VALUE of category_used (and both products' category) to the canonical 'fragrances' under the flag. Key and type are unchanged, so the change is additive-safe; flag OFF stays byte-identical.

CR4: the link A2b uses role 'classify' after the S81-06 consent gate (url_routes.py:233-238), so a Claude-routed classify never runs below consent 3. The consent gate must stay before the reserve and before compare_from_urls (2.4 keeps it).
